raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Fixes #6622. Adds a new `--max-payload-size` CLI flag (default **10 MB**) that controls the maximum size of incoming HTTP request bodies across all supported ASGI backends (Uvicorn and Granian).

### The problem

When sending large JSON payloads (e.g. ~10 MB with base64-encoded images) to the SGLang HTTP server, requests were rejected with a size-limit error. The root cause was Granian HTTP/1.1 defaulting `HTTP1Settings.max_buffer_size` to ~408 KB, while Uvicorn exposes `h11_max_incomplete_event_size` without SGLang wiring it up.

### What changed

**New config field** in `Serving` namespace (`python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/fields/serving.py`):
```python
max_payload_size: int = 10 * 1024 * 1024
```
Accessible via CLI: `--max-payload-size` or env var `SGLANG_MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE`.

**Applied to every ASGI server launch path** in `python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/http_server.py`:

| Backend | Parameter | Default before |
|---------|-----------|----------------|
| Granian HTTP/1.1 | `HTTP1Settings(max_buffer_size=...)` | 417,792 B (~408 KB) |
| Granian HTTP/2 | `HTTP2Settings(initial_stream_window_size=...)` | 1,048,576 B (1 MB) |
| Uvicorn (all modes) | `h11_max_incomplete_event_size=...` | h11 internal default |

All 4 launch paths (single-tokenizer Granian, multi-tokenizer Granian, SSL-refresh Uvicorn, default Uvicorn) now forward the value.

### Test plan

- [x] `py_compile` on all touched files passes (`serving.py`, `field_order.py`, `http_server.py`)
- [ ] `python -m sglang.launch_server --help` shows `--max-payload-size`
- [ ] `curl -X POST server/v1/chat/completions -d @10mb.json` succeeds with default 10 MB limit
- [ ] Set `--max-payload-size 20971520` then 20 MB payload accepted; 21 MB rejected with 413

### Checklist

- [x] I have read the contributing guide
- [x] I have signed-off my commits (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [x] CLA signed
- [ ] Tests added / CI passes (repo-scale tests require a GPU, out of scope for this flag wiring change)

Hey @ispobock @CatherineSue @slin1237 @merrymercy @JustinTong0323 👋

This PR adds a `--max-payload-size` CLI flag (default 10 MB) wired to Granian HTTP1/HTTP2 settings and Uvicorn h11 config — addressing issue #6622 where >~400 KB JSON bodies with base64 multimodal inputs were being rejected by Granian's default `max_buffer_size`.

Changes are minimal: 3 files, +20/-1 LOC, all syntax-validated. No GPU needed to review — would appreciate a quick pass when you have a moment 🙏

Noticed all FAIL checks are **infrastructure / pre-run gate** (`pr-gate`, `call-gate`, `Check PR title`, `check-changes`, `pr-test-*-finish`) — no lint or actual test failures on your changes. The `pr-gate` jobs fire when the PR is missing the `run-ci` label (repo-level triage workflow), `Check PR title` enforces the `[Area]: description` convention, and the `pr-test-*-finish` jobs are downstream aggregators that fail whenever upstream gates fail. Close+reopen to kick a fresh run — if you'd like full CI, a maintainer will need to add `run-ci`.

Closing this along with all other open PRs from this account, and blocking the account from sgl-project.

Over two days it opened 37 PRs, none merged: near-duplicates of the same change (four for `pp_proxy_tensors` alone), resubmissions of PRs closed the day before, test PRs, and runtime changes with no test, repro, or numbers.

Every PR here costs maintainer review time and CI. Accounts that flood the queue with unverified PRs will be closed and blocked the same way.
